verdict.rationale: Jan's local-first architecture and 'zero data collection until you say so' policy imply strong user control over data since everything runs on-device by default, giving users inherent power over retention (jan-docs-5, jan-docs-2, jan-gh-18). However, there is no explicit documentation of retention settings, chat history deletion, or data export/removal tools. Missing for 10: explicit UI/settings for deleting conversation history or model data, data export controls, and any documented retention policy for cloud-connected models.
